svg.title: Growth-rate precision from two kinds of record
svg.desc: Panel a: one simulated epidemic growing at 0.08 per day from fifty infections per day, recorded as an environmental signal sampled every two days with log-normal noise and as daily reported counts with one percent reporting. Panel b: standard error of the estimated growth rate against days of data, for the environmental signal in closed form (checked by 800 simulations) and for Poisson counts at ten, one and one tenth of a percent reporting. Which record is more precise depends on the reporting fraction and the length of the record. Assumed values; detection time is not compared.
svg.title: Growth-rate precision from two kinds of record
